newsitem.title: USA: Genesis to pay $0.66 qtly distribution.
newsitem.headline: Genesis to pay $0.66 qtly distribution.

text.p: Genesis Energy LP said Wednesday that it would pay its first quarterly distribution of $0.66 per common unit on May 15 to common unitholders of record April 30.
The company said its Minimum Quarterly Distribution is generally $0.50 per common unit.

It said the first distribution was raised include 29 days from December 3, the closing date of the initial public offering. Future minimum quarterly distributions will be paid on or about 45 days after the end of each calendar quarter, the company said, adding that future record dates should be on or about the last day of the month following the end of the calendar quarter.
